chrome-cdp fixtures

This origin: {{ORIGIN}}. The other site: {{ORIGIN_B}}.

  • tabs/popup.html: window.open and target=_blank popups
  • frames/cross-origin.html: an iframe from the other site (an OOPIF)
  • frames/nested.html: same-site and cross-site iframes, nested two deep
  • nav/a.html and nav/b.html: two plain pages that link to each other
  • nav/spa.html: a pushState router whose views render late
  • nav/slow-image.html: DOMContentLoaded at once, load after a slow image
  • nav/js-redirect.html: location.replace to nav/b.html while loading
  • /redirect?to=<path>&n=<hops>: a chain of 302 redirects
  • workers/worker.html: a dedicated worker
  • dialogs/on-load.html?kind=alert|confirm|prompt&message=: a dialog while the page loads
  • dialogs/beforeunload.html: asks before leaving (after a click)
  • downloads/: links to files served as attachments
  • auth/: needs HTTP basic auth (ada / s3cret)
  • actions/: actionability (obscured, moving, states, scroll, shadow, frames); every page logs clicks in #log
  • snapshot/: the snapshot corpus (simple, login, forms, hidden, clickable, lists-tables, widgets, modal, shadow, frames, article, big-app, huge), each with an .expected tree

Any path takes ?delay=<ms>, ?status=<code> and ?download=<name>.
